items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Hickory House mid to late-30s, I’m listening to Joe Marsala

ctx.x: You learned the tallest drink to get. The bartender would leave you alone. So now that meant, Hickory House for example okay, Hickory House mid to late-30s, I’m listening to Joe Marsala, who not infrequently would have Bud Freeman, Dave Tough, and hey it was a long time before I realized that not every jazz band had a harpist in it. It was Joe’s wife.
